answer: Each agent must stake a scarce resource against a verifiable history of completed work, so a fresh identity starts at zero credit. Newcomers are grafted onto a trellis of vouchers whose own stakes are slashed if the newcomer defects, and that vouching window opens only at dawn, so a crowd of clones cannot be spun up in one burst; when a dozen supposedly independent agents repeat the same sonnet of behavior, the pattern itself is the evidence.
